slides.headline: The Horrorland Scream Park, Oct. 22 to 25
slides.body: Open 7 to 10 p.m. Thursday through Sunday at Jungle Island in Miami. Tickets cost $39.99 for haunted houses, scare zones, and Circus of Terror.

slides.headline: Sounds of Screams, Oct. 22 to 25
slides.body: The 13-acre haunt runs 6 to 11 p.m. at the Miami-Dade Fair Expo Center in Miami. One ticket covers five haunted houses, rides, scare zones, and live entertainment.

slides.headline: House of Horror Haunted Carnival, Oct. 22 to 25
slides.body: The Halloween carnival is at Tropical Park in Miami. Hours are 6 to 11 p.m. Thursday and Sunday, and 6 p.m. to midnight Friday and Saturday.

slides.headline: Nightmare Village, Oct. 22 to 25
slides.body: Xtreme Action Park in Fort Lauderdale hosts the indoor haunt 7 to 10 p.m. Thursday through Sunday. Tickets cost $40 to $55.
